warnings: capex: one caption per series — 2 fiscal year(s) (2016-12-31..2017-12-31) keep the tag the earlier years used, which the filer still files, instead of a higher-priority caption that appeared later (a change of definition, not of business)

sales_investments: 1 derived quarter(s) (2015-12-31) came out negative — the fiscal-year (or year-to-date) figure and the leg subtracted from it are on different bases (a restatement, reclassification or discontinued operations); not shown

quarters not derived (the year-to-date fact's tag has no shorter leg in the same tag: the 10-Qs carried the figure in another caption; flagged basis_break_quarterly): other_opex 2013-12-31, other_opex 2014-12-31, total_opex 2013-12-31, operating_income 2013-12-31, operating_income 2014-12-31, interest_expense 2024-12-31, other_nonoperating 2016-12-31, other_nonoperating 2019-12-31, other_nonoperating 2020-12-31, pretax_income 2009-12-31, da 2009-12-31, da 2010-12-31...

restricted cash: in 30 period(s), 2019-03-31..2026-06-30 the cash line is the filed cash + restricted cash total (CashCashEquivalentsRestrictedCashAndRestrictedCashEquivalents, the cash-flow statement's total, read where the annual report filed no CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue for the date); in 12 period(s), 2022-12-31..2026-06-30 the restricted part is the restricted-cash figure filed for the same date (RestrictedCash, RestrictedCashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue); that part is shown on the 'Restricted cash (included in cash above)' line and deducted from cash wherever net cash, net cash per share and the ROIC proxy's invested capital are computed; in 18 period(s), 2019-03-31..2023-09-30 no figure separates the restricted part, so where those metrics are computed they still count restricted cash as cash (net cash overstated, net debt understated by the restricted amount; flagged incl_restricted_* and labelled 'some periods incl. restricted cash' on the metric; growth across a change between the two bases is blank)

growth across filing generations: 17 annual growth cell(s) are blank because the year and the year before come from different filings that disagree (one restated by a later filing — discontinued operations, an accounting change, a recast — the other as originally filed; or a capex caption change): buybacks (2013-12-31); capex (2013-12-31, 2018-12-31); cash (2012-12-31); deferred_taxes (2013-12-31); fcf (2013-12-31); income_tax (2013-12-31); ocf (2013-12-31); other_lt_assets (2019-12-31); other_lt_liab (2017-12-31); prepaids_other_current (2020-12-31); pretax_income (2013-12-31); revenue (2013-12-31); ...

restricted cash: 7 growth cell(s) are blank because one of the two periods deducts restricted cash and the other still counts it as cash (no figure separates it there; flagged incl_restricted_*): net_cash (FY ending 2019-12-31, 2022-12-31; quarters 2019-03-31, 2019-06-30, 2019-09-30, 2019-12-31, 2022-12-31)
